AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JULY 2, 2019
REGULAR MEETING
  6:15 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Margarita L. Rios, Mayor
  Luigi Vernola, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Leonard Shryock, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Rios

ROLL CALL
   Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Assessor Parcel Number 8045-008-902; Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez,
  City Manager; Negotiating Party: State of California; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

  II.  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR.
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager; regarding negotiations with Norwalk
  City Employees Association.

  III.  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957.6; CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR.
  Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus M. Gomez; regarding negotiations with the Norwalk
  Association of Management Employees.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Rios

INVOCATION
  Pastor Gerald Mitchell
  Pioneer Baptist Church

FLAG SALUTE
  Eva Ceballos

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to recognize Hometown Heroes.

  II.  City Council to declare July as Parks Make Life Better month in the City of Norwalk.

  III.  City Council to recognize 10 Minute Walk to the Park Movement.

  IV.  City Council to recognize Norwalk Public Safety and Sheriff Deputies for exemplary service to the
  community.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  Recap of the Panera Bread Grand Opening.

  2.  Recap of the Ring Video Doorbell Rebate Event.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR
 Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of June 18
  and June 25, 2019. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period May 19, 2019 – June 1,
  2019, in the total amount of $932,046.24. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  June 12, 2019 – June 25, 2019, in the total amount of $3,395,015.85. 640

  Report

  4.  AMENDMENT NO. 4 – GRANT RESEARCH AND WRITING SERVICES - Staff recommends City
  Council approve Amendment No. 4 with Blais and Associates, Inc., in an amount not to exceed
  $50,000 for grant research and writing services from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020; and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the
  City Attorney. 623

  Report

  5.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-40 – FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT AND
  STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE FUND – Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-40, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK ADOPTING THE
  TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT AND STATE TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT
  FUNDS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019/20. 1105-02

  Report

  6.  PROJECT NO. 7230 - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ALONG SAN ANTONIO DRIVE AND CIVIC
  CENTER DRIVE - Staff recommends City Council approve the plans and specifications for the traffic
  signal improvements on San Antonio Drive from Rosecrans Avenue to Civic Center Drive and along
  Civic Center Drive from Norwalk Boulevard to Bloomfield Avenue, authorize the advertisement of bids,
  and set a bid opening date of August 15, 2019. 1005-04-7230

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  7.  ADVISORY BODIES - Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

HEARING

  8.  RESOLUTION NO. 19-42 - APPEAL OF PROPERTY MAINTENANCE AND BUILDING
  REHABILITATION APPEALS BOARD DECISION RELATIVE TO DECLARATION AND ABATEMENT
  OF A PUBLIC NUISANCE ON THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT ASSESSOR’S PARCEL NO. 8078-010-
  018, NORWALK, CALIFORNIA – Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-42, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK SETTING FORTH ITS
  FINDINGS OF FACT AND DECISION RELATIVE TO THE DENIAL OF THE APPEAL AND
  CONFIRMING THE ACTION AND DECISION OF THE PROPERTY MAINTENANCE AND BUILDING
  REHABILITATION APPEALS BOARD RELATIVE TO THE DECLARATION AND ABATEMENT OF A
  PUBLIC NUISANCE AT THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT ASSESSOR’S PARCEL NO. 8078-010-018
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA. 305-03-07

  Report
 REPORTS

  9.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY REPAIR WORK – ALLARD STREET – WEST OF NORWALK
  BOULEVARD - Staff recommends City Council confirm the emergency repair work completed by
  Precision Pipeline, Inc. in the amount of $3,876.66. 955

  Report

  10. PROJECT NO. 7228 - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ALONG ROSECRANS AVENUE FROM
  STUDEBAKER ROAD TO CARMENITA ROAD – RESOLUTION NO. 19-41 – BUDGET
  AMENDMENT - Staff recommends City Council approve the plans and specifications for the traffic
  signal improvements along Rosecrans Avenue, authorize the advertisement of bids, and set a bid
  opening date of August 14, 2019; and adopt Resolution No. 19-41, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR
  2019/20 ADOPTED BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE MEASURE R FUNDS FOR PROJECT NO. 7228 -
  TRAFFIC SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ALONG ROSECRANS AVENUE FROM STUDEBAKER ROAD
  TO CARMENITA ROAD, in the amount of $20,000. 1005-04-7228

  Report

  11. PROJECT NO. 7229 - AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE TRAFFIC
  SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ALONG STUDEBAKER ROAD FROM ROSECRANS AVENUE TO
  ALONDRA BOULEVARD – RESOLUTION NO. 19-43 – BUDGET AMENDMENT – Staff recommends
  City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 19-43, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE MEASURE R FUNDS FOR PROJECT NO. 7229 - TRAFFIC
  SIGNAL IMPROVEMENTS ALONG STUDEBAKER ROAD FROM ROSECRANS AVENUE TO
  ALONDRA BOULEVARD, in the amount of $20,000;

  b.  approve Amendment No. 1 with Land CM Corp. in the amount of $20,000 for the administration
  services in the federal funding reimbursement process;

  c.  award a construction contract to International Line Builder’s, Inc., in the amount of $664,484.00 for
  Project No. 7229 traffic signal improvements along Studebaker Road; and

  d.  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments with International Line
  Builder’s, Inc., provided there is funding in the budget, and Amendment No. 1 with Land CM Corp.,
  on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney. 1005-04-7229

  Report

  12. USE OF CIVIC CENTER LAWN AND PARKING AREAS – PAKISTAN INDEPENDENCE DAY EVENT -
  Staff requests direction from City Council regarding the approval of the use of the Civic Center lawn
  and parking areas for August 17, 2019. 920-01-02

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated June 27, 2019.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
